description: Re-check one listed L402 endpoint now, after its operator changed something. Input: id, an endpoint id from the newest Agent Payments Index probe file (the hosts page at https://loopxxi.com/agent-payments-index/hosts and the probe file list each endpoint with its id and its last daily result). The tool sends one live request to that endpoint with the method the list gives (GET or POST), no request body, no buyer headers and the user agent LoopXXI-Index-Recheck/1. It does not follow redirects and stops after 10 seconds. Returns the same fields as a row of the daily probe file (status, outcome, challenge scheme, whether a macaroon and an invoice came back, the invoice amount and network), a plain likely cause and fix, checked_at, and the last daily result for comparison. The macaroon and the invoice string are never returned. A timeout, a refused connection or an error status from the endpoint is a valid result, and the call is charged. A failure on our side is not charged. At most one live request per endpoint per 10 minutes, 30 per host per hour and 60 per hour in all; inside a limit the call is refused before an invoice, with the age of the last result and the time to retry. We do not sell a stored answer. The daily probe stays at one request per endpoint per day; a re-check is a separate request that a buyer asked for. Re-check results are not published and are not added to the daily files. Price: 21 sats per call.

id.description: Endpoint id from the newest Agent Payments Index probe file.

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 21 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

name: l402_recheck
